scope: iOS sendAdmission P0 increment only; no full30/4 rerun; no new UI gesture or physical-device claim
environment: Xcode27.2 / SDK27.2 / JobsIM Picker iOS26.5 arm64 simulator

contract.Conversation: membershipGeneration:string; sendAdmission:string, empty when not currently allowed
contract.newMessage: capture original sendAdmission before enqueue (before attachment upload); preserve with original restoreEpoch and clientMsgId
contract.featureGate: fresh bootstrap.features.send_admission=true before POST or legacy reconciliation; old binary fails closed
contract.legacy: missing snapshot permanently excludes automatic pending, original BLOB unchanged; explicit original-body POST may return an already committed fact under current read ACL, never create a missing old intent
contract.changed: 409 SEND_ADMISSION_CHANGED freezes permanently; refresh/rejoin/reaccept never rewrites original payload or uses new ID
contract.schema: send-admission-freeze adds freeze_reason and freezes old missing values without destructive rebuild

coverage: old SQLite schema upgrade, exact Outbox BLOB hex unchanged, restart and immutable ID
same original enqueue cannot unfreeze; changing original admission conflicts
formal missing snapshot frozen, demo queue isolated
missing fresh snapshot retains draft; upload snapshot stays original after metadata refresh
frozen native message component does not display server acceptance
unobserved group leave/rejoin changes current member generation and admission; old intent stays frozen and absent from server history, new explicit intent succeeds
direct delete and block/unblock/reopen/reaccept: committed original can reconcile while new sending is forbidden; uncommitted original does not revive
pre-upgrade real legacy body commits on old8443; same body/ID succeeds after upgrade; no-snapshot uncommitted ID returns SEND_ADMISSION_CHANGED without history insertion
boundaries: previous30/4/1 and18+4 external reports unchanged; their results are earlier baselines
new gate does not implement full sync, qualified receipt/global deletion, transfer/backup, account cancellation or advanced features
native component assertions are not a full new UI gesture run
backend atomic fence and multi-host limits are evidenced by backend owner, not inferred from these iOS tests
test preparation bearer is Keychain-only; no credentials or admission opaque values emitted into report
